title: Ruhun da ke Bayan Gumakan
intro: A cikin inuwar babban gudun hijira daga zalunci, wannan mutum mai ban mamaki yana jira a cikin daji. Yayin da shugaban wata al'umma da aka zaɓa ya hau kan tsauni mai tsarki don yin tarayya ta Allah, babban gwaji ya faɗo wa waɗanda aka bari a baya. Wannan mutum ya yi amfani da lokacin don sake fasalin imanin al'umma gaba ɗaya. Lokacin da shugaban ya dawo da gaskiya, an zartar da hukunci na musamman kuma na har abada. Za ku iya gano ko wanene wannan ruhi mai jayayya da wayo?
clues: Na yi tafiya tare da mutanen da aka 'yantar daga hannun wani mai iko azzalumi ta hanyar alamu masu ban mamaki.
Lokacin da shugabansu ya hau kan dutse don samun jagora, na jira a tsakanin waɗanda suka rage.
Na tattara ƙarfe masu daraja daga kayan adonsu na kuma ƙera shi ya zama wani abu da ke samar da sauti.
Ta hanyar wannan halitta, na shawo kan wata tsara cewa sun sami allahnsu a cikin daji.
Da shugaban ya dawo, sai aka ware ni aka tambaye ni abin da ya sa na yi irin wannan yaudara.
Hukuncina a wannan duniyar shi ne kada wani ya taɓa ni ko ya kusance ni, alamar kunya da nake ɗauka har abada.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
